sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: As an administrator, you will command with an iron fist today, predicts Ganesha. In the afternoon, you may find change slowly creeping in; you may discover a more harmonious approach to managing people as compared to a dictatorial style. You will come out with flying colours from any adverse situations.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Unexpected money developments could brighten your day today, Taurus. Perhaps you will get a raise or an increase in some other form of income. Technology could be involved in some way, or a long-term goal you've been striving for finally brings in some benefits. There might be uncertainty about when it's coming or exactly how much it will be, but the outcome will be gratifying all the same!

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Get an early start on your socializing for the day, as you'll crave privacy when the Moon enters Aries this afternoon. Peace and quiet will lead you to valuable insights as evening unfolds and Luna aspects Neptune, Pluto, and Uranus. Emerge from solitude to make power moves, then retreat once more to enjoy the victories you've scored. Nostalgia and sweetness blend perfectly while the Sun and Venus rx unite tonight.

readings.text: This is a favourable day to make swift progress in your business. You shall get more orders and you would do well to improve the quality of your goods and services. There sure is money to be made.

You would probably prefer not to have to worry about money, especially this week. But since it's a necessary part of life, you prefer to worry about broader things - that which you can't control. At this time, your money life is more ideas than reality, thanks to aspects happening in the area of your chart associated with past lives, institutions, the unconscious mind, and dreams. Your efforts to make any serious changes to your money situation now may need more time to develop.

readings.text: A great day is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. This is the perfect time to finish your pending work and meet your targets . Due to stress you shall feel drained by the end of the day. Health needs care now. Spend some time with your family.

Today's aspect gives you the feeling that nothing will be perfect unless you do it - do you recognize those feelings? The anxiety in this mindset is fairly particular to you. The work ethic, the attention to detail, the stress about whether or not something's perfect - all you! Well, take a deep breath and remind yourself that nothing is ever perfect. What's most important is how people feel - how YOU feel.
